name: expired-domains
description: Save domain lists from expireddomains.net pages you open and export them to CSV, TXT or clipboard.

scripts.build:all: wxt build && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.zip:all: wxt zip && wxt zip -b firefox && wxt zip -b edge
scripts.lint: biome check src/ tests/ wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src/ tests/ wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && biome check src/ tests/ wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts && vitest run && npm run check:invariants
